changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Issue (November 11, 2026)
changes.detail: On nodes that have Linux syscall auditing enabled, such as Container-Optimized OS nodes where you enabled Linux auditd logging , mounting Cloud Storage FUSE CSI driver volumes can hang indefinitely. Pods that use these volumes don't start and remain in a status such as Init:0/1 or ContainerCreating . Pods that are being deleted remain in the Terminating state, and node drains, including drains during node pool upgrades, might not complete. Pod events show errors similar to the following: MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "VOLUME_NAME" : rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadl
